authoredLandmarksRequired.reason: Outside the collected building footprint sample; no OSM height or structure.

limitations: Stage A only: compact CBD area, not Greater Sydney.
Footpaths and crossings are DERIVED from road geometry because the public Overpass endpoint was unreachable (TLS failure). They are not OSM-tagged footways.
Building footprints exist only inside the legacy 1.2 x 1.4 km sample box; The Rocks, Circular Quay and Bennelong Point have no collected footprints.
Elevation is absent; all geometry is at y = 0 except water at y = -0.4.
The Harbour Bridge and Opera House are not modelled; their real coordinates are listed in authoredLandmarksRequired.
No rail corridors, bus routes, ferry wharves or terrain are included.
Water is a clipped union with holes ignored; islands such as Fort Denison are covered by water.
